Peer review other engineers' packages against technical quality, production realism, and engineering value, with part-specific evidence for every score. jobs.title: Call for Applications: Grant Making Panel (GMP) // Convocatoria de Solicitudes:
jobs.description: [El texto en español se encuentra a continuación] 1. Call for new GMP members The International Trans Fund (ITF) is seeking applications from committed activists to be members of its Grant Making Panel (GMP). Applicants may be based and organize within any region of the world. 2. About the ITF The International Trans Fund (ITF) is a participatory grantmaking fund led by trans activists and donors. We resource trans-led groups globally to advance human rights, self-determination, well-being, and movement power. We have a specific focus on supporting groups with limited access to funding. 3. Role of the GMP The GMP reviews eligible applications and makes funding decisions consistent with ITF’s mission, values, and priorities. Decisions of the GMP are final, pending Board ratification. The key responsibilities of the Grant Making Panel are to: Participate in online GMP training. Join one annual 6-day in-person meeting (location varies) or a virtual equivalent. Take part in online discussions and at least 75% of scheduled online meetings. Lead grantmaking tasks: Encourage trans communities to apply. Review, score, and provide feedback on applications. Make collective funding decisions. Recommend grantmaking priorities and advise on strategy as relevant. Strictly uphold ITF confidentiality and conflict-of-interest policies. 4. Profile of the Activists we are Seeking Before deciding to apply, please confirm that: You are committed to advancing trans rights and building sustainable trans movements. Your peers consider you credible and trustworthy. You value participatory grantmaking and collective, movement-accountable decision-making. 5. What “trans” means at ITF We use “trans” as a political term for people whose gender identity or expression differs from their sex assigned at birth, including binary and non-binary identities and culturally specific identities worldwide. We do not privilege any identity or terminology over another. 6. Time Commitment Annual training: 3–5 hours. Application review: 30–50 applications over ~6 weeks (~50 hours/year). Annual meeting: 6 days + travel (in-person or virtual). 7. Candidate Qualifications Essential Identify as trans (refer to item 5 above). Minimum 3 years of direct trans activism, ideally as a regional and/or international level. Recognized by trans activists in your region as a community activist/leader. Fluency (spoken and written) in English or Spanish. Able and willing to work in a diverse environment (activists and donors). Passport enabling international travel (for in-person meetings). Reliable in meeting tasks and deadlines. Experience managing and reporting on grants for trans work. 8. Conflict of Interest GMP members (and immediate family members) may not be significantly involved in any group applying to ITF during their tenure and may not benefit financially from assessed or existing ITF grants (See ITF Conflict of Interest Policy). Please note that this means that if you are part of/involved in an organization and selected as a member of the GMP, the organization will not be eligible to apply for grants during their tenure. 9. Term & Compensation Term: Three (3) years, appointed by the Board. Compensation:USD $1,500 per one-year grant cycle, plus covered travel and per diem for ITF meetings. 10. Selection Process The Board will appoint seven activists with attention to diversity across gender identities/expressions and inclusion of further-marginalized groups within trans communities. We highly encourage trans men and trans masculine folks to apply. 11. How to Apply Please submit an application in BambooHR by November 30, 2026. We intend to inform all candidates of our decisions by January 2027. // 1. Convocatoria para nuevas personas integrantes del PCA El Fondo Internacional Trans (FIT) busca activistas comprometides para formar parte de su Panel de Concesión de Apoyos (PCA) . Las personas solicitantes pueden residir y organizarse en cualquier región del mundo. 2. Acerca del FIT El Fondo Internacional Trans (FIT) es un fondo participativo de apoyos financieros liderado por activistas trans y donantes que lo apoyan. Proporcionamos recursos a grupos liderados por personas trans en todo el mundo para promover los derechos humanos, la autodeterminación, el bienestar y el empoderamiento de los movimientos, especialmente para aquellos grupos con acceso limitado a financiación. 3. Función del PCA El PCA revisa las solicitudes que cumplen los requisitos y toma decisiones de financiamiento acordes con la misión, los valores y las prioridades de FIT. Las decisiones del PCA son definitivas, a la espera de la ratificación de la junta directiva. Las principales responsabilidades del panel de concesión de apoyos son: Participar en la capacitación en línea del PCA. Participar en una reunión anual presencial de 6 días (la ubicación varía) o en su equivalente virtual. Participar en los debates en línea y en al menos el 75% de las reuniones en línea programadas. Liderar las tareas de concesión de apoyos financieros: Alentar a las comunidades trans a presentar una solicitud. Revisar, calificar y proporcionar comentarios sobre las solicitudes. Tomar decisiones colectivas sobre el financiamiento. Recomendar prioridades en la concesión de apoyos financieros y asesorar sobre la estrategia pertinente. Respetar estrictamente las políticas de confidencialidad y de conflicto de intereses del FIT. 4. Perfil de las personas activistas que buscamos Antes de decidirse a presentar su solicitud, confirme que: Tienes compromiso con el avance de los derechos de las personas trans y la construcción de movimientos trans sostenibles. Tus pares te consideran una persona creíble y digna de confianza. Valoras la concesión participativa de apoyos financieros y la toma de decisiones colectiva y responsable ante el movimiento. 5. ¿Qué significa “trans” para el FIT? Usamos “trans” como término político para referirnos a las personas cuya identidad o expresión de género difiere del sexo que se les asignó al nacer, incluyendo identidades binarias y no binarias, así como identidades culturalmente específicas en todo el mundo. No privilegiamos ninguna identidad ni terminología sobre otra. 6. Compromiso de tiempo Capacitación anual: 3-5 horas. Revisión de solicitudes: entre 30 y 50 solicitudes durante aproximadamente 6 semanas ( aproximadamente 50 horas al año ). Reunión anual: 6 días + viaje (presencial o virtual). 7. Requisitos de la persona postulante Básico Identificarse como persona trans (consultar el punto 5 anterior). Mínimo 3 años de activismo trans directo, idealmente a nivel regional y/o internacional. Tener reconocimiento de activistas trans de tu región como activista/líder comunitarie. Fluidez (oral y escrita) en inglés o español . Capaz y con disposición a trabajar en un entorno diverso (activistas y donantes). Pasaporte que permite viajar internacionalmente (para reuniones presenciales). Confiable en el cumplimiento de tareas y plazos. Experiencia en la gestión y presentación de informes sobre financiamientos para proyectos relacionados con personas trans. 8. Conflicto de intereses: Las personas integrantes del PCA (y sus familiares directos) no podrán participar activamente en ningún grupo que solicite financiamiento al FIT durante su mandato, ni beneficiarse económicamente de los apoyos financieros del FIT ya concedidos o en curso ( véase la Política de Conflicto de Intereses de la FIT ). Ten en cuenta que, si formas parte de una organización o participas en ella y se te selecciona como integrante del PCA, dicha organización no podrá solicitar apoyos financieros durante su mandato. 9. Duración y remuneración Duración del mandato: Tres (3) años, designado por la Junta. Compensación: 1.500 dólares estadounidenses por ciclo anual de apoyos financieros, además de los gastos de viaje y dietas cubiertos para las reuniones del FIT. 10. Proceso de selección: La junta designará a siete activistas, prestando especial atención a la diversidad de identidades y expresiones de género, así como a la inclusión de grupos más marginados dentro de las comunidades trans. Alentamos encarecidamente a hombres trans y personas trans masculinas a presentar su solicitud. 11. Cómo solicitar Por favor, envía tu solicitud a través de BambooHR antes del 30 de noviembre de 2026. Tenemos previsto informar a todas las personas postulantes de nuestras decisiones antes de enero de 2027. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.description: This is a remote position. A producer role developing and producing exceptional journalist-led content with a globally traveling on-camera presenter, across short, medium and long formats. Organization: Confidential client in the media sector Location: Fully remote – open to candidates anywhere in the world Role Type: Full-time | Consultant-contractor The opportunity Our client's co-founder is an on-camera journalist and presenter who is constantly moving between countries, communities and stories. The client is looking for a producer to develop and produce exceptional content with him as the presenter. He is the talent. You will work closely with him behind the scenes to shape the strategy, find the stories, develop the angles, research the facts and write the scripts that bring his journalism to life. As co-founder of a media company that helps people tell the stories traditional media overlooks, he is building a presenter-led output across short, medium and long formats: everything from one-minute reactions and recurring explainer series to podcasts, interviews and documentaries. You will help decide what he should cover, why it matters and how he should tell the story on camera. About the organization Our client is a media company that helps the 99% be seen by empowering people to tell their own stories, because traditional media focuses on the 1%. Its co-founder presents the journalism this role will build. What you will do Build a strategy for presenter-led content around his voice, interests, travel and access. Proactively pitch original stories, timely reactions and unexpected angles, particularly around social justice. Research subjects thoroughly, find credible sources and identify the details that make a story compelling. Write scripts for on-camera delivery, with natural spoken language, strong hooks and clear storytelling. Develop distinctive shows and repeatable formats the presenter hosts, including explainers, podcasts and documentaries. Identify contributors, interview opportunities and stories in the places the presenter is visiting. Prepare presenter briefs, interview questions, filming plans and story outlines so he arrives ready to shoot. Produce his on-camera delivery, whether remotely or on location, with feedback on clarity, pacing and performance. Work with editors to shape his footage into strong finished stories, including supporting footage, graphics and sound. Develop titles, thumbnails and social copy that make people want to watch. Study performance and audience retention, then apply what you learn to the next piece. Protect factual accuracy and editorial integrity from the first pitch through to publication. What you bring A proven track record in digital journalism, video production or documentary storytelling. Experience producing presenter-led content and working directly with on-camera talent. Published work that has generated millions of views , with a clear explanation of your contribution. Excellent research, scripting and storytelling skills. A strong understanding of how audiences behave across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Facebook. The ability to write both a sharp short-form hook and a sustained narrative for a longer film. The initiative and organization to keep projects moving around a demanding travel schedule. A deep commitment to social justice and a decolonial understanding of power, politics and representation: you question whose perspective is treated as authoritative, whose experiences are overlooked and who benefits from the way a story is told, while keeping the journalistic discipline to interrogate your own assumptions, check every claim and follow the evidence. How the engagement works You will contract directly with Apricot, which manages contracting, invoicing/payroll, payments, and administrative support. Contracting arrangements, monthly compensation, time-zone overlap and the exact start date will be confirmed before an offer. Your work will be based on the agreed scope and deliverables. You are expected to provide your own laptop and basic equipment, maintain reliable connectivity and a secure working environment, and follow required security controls, including two-factor authentication. You will collaborate with the client's distributed production and editorial teams. We welcome candidates from different backgrounds and lived experiences, and selection is based on the requirements of the role; if you need a reasonable adjustment during the hiring process, please let us know. About Apricot Apricot is a nonprofit sourcing firm connecting displaced and underserved professionals from Palestine and the wider MENA region with global employment opportunities. We combine a social-impact mission with high-quality recruitment delivery for international clients. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.description: About the role Triangulate Digital is a paid media agency for VC and PE-backed B2B SaaS companies, mostly in the US and Canada. We run paid media mainly on Google and LinkedIn, for clients spending from about $30k to over $100k a month. I'm hiring my first Paid Media Operator: someone who can execute accurately today and grow into owning clients. You'll start by running campaigns alongside me: building, optimising, QA and reporting. Once you've proved the quality of your work, you'll progress toward owning 2 to 4 accounts end to end, including the client relationship. Ownership is earned on evidence, not on a fixed date. It's a full-time, fully remote role, and a full-time commitment to Triangulate. Why work with me I've spent 10 years in B2B SaaS marketing. I worked at Directive, one of the biggest B2B SaaS agencies, then spent 5 years consulting for SaaS companies across the US and Canada. Now I'm building Triangulate Digital, and you'd be my first hire. Real brands, real budgets. Well-known B2B SaaS companies spending $30k to over $100k a month. Learn directly from me. No layers of account managers. You get my playbooks and feedback every week. A clear path up. Start by executing, then run your own clients end to end. Your pay grows as you take on more. Shape how we work. As the first person on the team, you help build the processes everyone after you will use. What you'll do First 90 days: execute reliably across your assigned accounts, with no preventable errors, missed deadlines or rework for me Build campaigns in Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads, and other channels where they fit Run weekly optimisation on each account: budgets and pacing, bids, search terms, audiences and creative rotation QA everything before it goes live: conversion tracking, UTMs, targeting and budgets Connect channel performance to CRM and attribution data, so we judge campaigns on pipeline and revenue, not platform metrics Maintain client dashboards, and draft weekly updates and monthly reports from our templates Spot problems early, such as broken tracking, overspend or spend with no conversions, and flag them the same day Help turn how we work into checklists, so the work gets more consistent over time Once you've earned client ownership Progress toward owning 2 to 4 accounts, with capacity set by account complexity and the quality you've shown Understand each client's goals, economics and measurement, and find the main thing holding performance back, even when it sits outside paid media Build and lead paid media strategies tied to pipeline and revenue Lead weekly client calls, day-to-day Slack, and monthly and quarterly business reviews What success looks like Campaigns launch with no tracking, targeting or budget errors Problems are flagged the same day you spot them, with a suggested fix Weekly updates and monthly reports land on time and need few edits I can trust a change you've made without re-checking it Over time, you run your clients without me carrying the strategy, and clients clearly understand what's happening, why, and what comes next The work reduces my review and correction time over time. If every task still needs to be rebuilt by me, the role isn't working. How we work together You start behind me. I lead client calls, strategy and sign-off at first. You join calls as you're ready, then lead them. Autonomy grows with trust. At first you propose changes and I approve them before they go live. Routine work, then whole clients, move to you as we build a track record together. Daily: a short end-of-day note in Slack covering what you did, what's next and anything blocked. Weekly: a 30-minute review of every account together. Hours: full-time and flexible, with at least 3 hours a day overlapping 1pm to 6pm UK time, and some overlap with US Eastern time for client calls once you own clients. Tools: Slack, Google Workspace, the ad platforms and the AI tools we use for reporting and analysis. What I'm looking for 2+ years of strong hands-on experience with Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads for B2B companies, ideally SaaS and ideally at an agency Experience running at least 3 accounts at once, with monthly budgets of $20k or more A strong understanding of B2B demand generation, ABM and measurement Experience using CRM and attribution data to judge paid media performance Confidence with conversion tracking: Google Tag Manager, GA4, the LinkedIn Insight Tag, and CRM data from HubSpot or Salesforce Clear written and verbal English, and the confidence to present recommendations to marketing leaders The habit of flagging issues early rather than waiting to be asked, and someone who follows a process precisely A track record of taking ownership when something is unclear, blocked or going wrong, with a specific example and measurable result Based outside the UK Nice to have: Meta, Reddit or Microsoft Ads; ABM and attribution tools such as 6sense, Demandbase or Fibbler; Looker Studio. Pay and contract Pay: $4,000 to $5,000 a month in USD to start, depending on experience and the scope you can own, and higher for candidates who can own clients from day one. Paid by bank transfer. Pay is reviewed as your responsibility grows, including when you start owning clients. Contract: full-time contractor agreement with an NDA. This is intended to be a full-time commitment to Triangulate Digital: you wouldn't take on other client work during your agreed working hours. Trial and notice: the first 90 days are an initial trial period. It starts with a 30-day paid trial on one live account, with 7 days' notice on either side. If it's working, at day 90 we move to an ongoing contractor agreement, with 30 days' notice on either side. What you get: hands-on training from me, and access to the playbooks, tools and resources I use across B2B SaaS accounts. You'll work with well-known B2B SaaS brands, and you can take time off when you need it, with notice. Hiring process Application form , about 15 minutes. Interview , 45 minutes: your experience, a walk through your career role by role, and your questions about the role. Paid practical assessment , 30 to 45 minutes: you receive a sanitised B2B SaaS ad account beforehand, then present what you would investigate, what you would change, what you would leave alone, what data is missing, and how confident you are in each recommendation. References: a quick chat with one or two people you've worked with. 30-day paid trial : on one live account, after references and contract signing. Live work proves reliability. Ongoing contract : if the fit is right, we review at day 90 and you move into the full role. How to apply: fill in the application form . I review applications as they come in. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable. Our stack is Python ( FastAPI ) on AWS , with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows. Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD . What You Will Do: Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end. Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails. Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production. Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality. Drive the full software development lifecycle , translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans. What We Are Looking For: 5+ years building and operating production backend systems , with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end. Deep fluency in your primary backend language , and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python ; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly. Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one. Sound reasoning under ambiguity : you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change. Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations , including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar). Professional written English , enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs. Even Better: AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience. Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions. A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal. How We Hire: We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build: 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit.. 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review. You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment. What We Offer: Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package. Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work. The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI , tackling hard problems with high ownership. A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement. If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk! Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Paid Ads Specialist
jobs.description: At JLV Construction, we specialize in high-end residential construction, whole-home renovations, additions, and historic preservation in New Orleans. In this role, you will build, manage, and optimize Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns. You will manage advertising budgets, test campaign improvements, monitor conversion tracking, and work with Marketing and Sales to understand which campaigns produce qualified leads and contribute to revenue. Pay and Benefits: Location: 100% remote. Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time . Schedule: You must consistently follow U.S. Central Time, including adjustments for U.S. daylight-saving time. Workweek: 45 scheduled hours per week, including a one-hour unpaid lunch each day and two paid 15-minute breaks each day. U.S. Holidays: At JLV, we follow the U.S. holiday schedule. Language: C1–C2 English or near native fluency required . Compensation: 10.00 - 14.00 USD per hour , depending on demonstrated experience and proficiency. Payment: Every two weeks. Work Arrangement: Full-time remote independent contractor. Reports To: Marketing Manager. Equipment: You must provide your own reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and professional home-office setup. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks (Contract)
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. Originally posted on Himalayas
